$comment: TypeScript dialect hook tests that vitest does not run on Windows (note BF section 4.1). On Windows these hooks never run: the gate registered there is Rust `derm hook <agent> <event>` (gates.json, lane 5bF), and the Claude plugin's TypeScript hook runs only in the sbx VM, which is Linux. Every test in these files has a holder in contracts/fixtures/hook-cases/ (5bA.json, 5bB.json replayed against `derm hook` by crates/derm-cli/tests/hook_cases_*.rs on every system, Windows included; manual.json ported by hand), and scripts/windows-holders.mjs, run in the Linux CI job, fails when one does not. Linux and macOS run these files as before.
